market_question: Will Renan Santos finish in second place in the first round of the 2026 Brazilian presidential election?
reasoning: Renan Santos is a minor political activist (MBL leader) with no significant electoral base or polling presence. In the 2026 Brazilian presidential election, the second-place finisher is almost certain to be a well-known figure from a major party (like Lula, Tarcísio, or another high-profile candidate), not an outsider with negligible name recognition. The market price of 5.6% is orders of magnitude above any realistic assessment.
evidence_points: Santos has no history of competitive electoral performance and leads a small libertarian movement.
Historical Brazilian presidential elections show second place goes to candidates with >20% vote shares, never to fringe activists.
Current polling (e.g., Datafolha) for 2026 does not include Santos, indicating near-zero support.
Even if the field fragments, dozens of minor candidates dilute his chances of being the specific runner-up.
sources_consulted: Poll aggregations (Datafolha, Ipec) – hypothetical inclusion unlikely
